_doc: Story-points source fallback chain, in priority order. Configured conversion. Used to determine the PREVIOUS/EXISTING SP for delta reporting, and as an input signal (not a replacement) for the deterministic estimator.

priority.description: Planned SP scraped from a Confluence baseline page. Authoritative when the issue is part of a captured baseline set. Not generally available for net-new issues outside that baseline.
Use for issues added to scope after a baseline was captured.
Use when Original Estimate is null. Convert using tshirt-to-sp.json.
Last resort fallback only. Note: customfield_10016 is NULL for all tickets in this workspace — do not rely on it.
